OPERATOR-ATTESTED — S6 Step 1, the PER-SLOT Bedrock invokability + temperature probe.

Run by the agent holding this ticket, from this environment, BEFORE any corpus spend.
Account 896586841071 / us-east-1. Caller identity arn:aws:iam::896586841071:user/joe_frontier
(`aws sts get-caller-identity`, exit 0). Probe timestamps 2026-08-02T21:36:10Z .. 21:36:26Z UTC.
Command: `aws bedrock-runtime converse --region us-east-1 --model-id <id>
--messages '[{"role":"user","content":[{"text":"Reply with the single word: ok"}]}]'
--inference-config '{"maxTokens":8}'` and the same with `,"temperature":0` added.

OUTCOME — BOTH SLOTS ARE INVOKABLE, so BOTH slots are measured. Verbatim results:

  slot      model id                          bare call                    temperature=0
  standard  us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6    OK  text='ok'                OK  text='ok'
                                              in=14 out=4 latency 710-900ms    in=14 out=4 710ms
  frontier  us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8      OK  text='ok'                REFUSED (see below)
                                              in=16 out=4 latency 832ms

  Exact frontier temperature=0 error string:
    An error occurred (ValidationException) when calling the Converse operation: The model
    returned the following errors: `temperature` is deprecated for this model.

  Also probed (not a slot, recorded for completeness):
    global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6        OK  text='ok'  in=14 out=4

THE TEMPERATURE REFUSAL IS NOT A BLOCKER — it confirms an existing mechanism, as the plan
predicted. `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8` is ALREADY enrolled in
`capabilities._MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` with `supports_temperature: False`
(`src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:126`, alongside its `global.` twin at :127), and the runner
withdraws the parameter from the request on that basis. So the corpus run never sends
`temperature` to the frontier slot. No capability-table change was needed.

TWO CORRECTIONS TO EARLIER EVIDENCE ON THIS TICKET, both material to the run shape:

1. The earlier probe comment listed `aws bedrock list-foundation-models` output that did NOT
   include any opus-4-8 id, which would have implied the frontier slot was unmeasurable and
   forced the plan's PARTIAL case. That inference would have been WRONG:
   `list-foundation-models` enumerates on-demand FOUNDATION models, not INFERENCE PROFILES,
   and the `us.`-prefixed profile id is exactly the form that is not a foundation model.
   Directly invoking `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8` succeeds. The frontier slot IS measurable.
2. Method note for reproducibility: `--cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out` is needed for
   `invoke-model`'s `--body` blob, NOT for `converse` (whose `--messages` is plain JSON).
   Separately, `--inference-config` may be passed ONCE only — giving it twice
   (`--inference-config maxTokens=8 --inference-config temperature=0`) is rejected client-side
   with `Unknown options`, which looks like an API refusal and is not one. A first attempt here
   failed that way; the real temperature refusal above came from the corrected single-flag form.
